# Data

Data files are **not** versioned by default (see `.gitignore`).

## `raw/` (you must provide these files)

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `lib1_and_2_B44-B45_Rb-pep_PEPTIDES_DATA.xlsx` | SIMBA proteomic peptide-phage display results. Sheet `ALL_PEPTIDES_scores_z_SD`. Columns used: `Unique Peptide`, `Category`, `Description`, `C_Pm-Rb_SIMBA-score`, `F_Pw-Rb_SIMBA-score`. |
| `source_proteins.fasta` | Full-length sequences (UniProt) of the five source proteins; used to give the pLMs the sequence context around each peptide. |

## `processed/` (generated by the notebooks)

| File | Created by | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `df_tp.csv` | 01 | WT peptide of each protein: `protein, uniprot_id, peptide, category, description, score_pm_rb, score_pw_rb` |
| `df_dms.csv` | 01 | Point mutants: `protein, uniprot_id, mutation, position, wt_aa, mut_aa, peptide, ..., score_pm_rb, score_pw_rb, delta_pm_rb, delta_pw_rb` |
| `wt_embeddings.npz` | 03 | WT embedding matrices, keys `<protein>__<model>`, shape *(18, embedding dim)* |
| `mutant_embedding_distances.csv` | 03 | Per mutant and model: `dist_local`, `dist_global`, `pos_1 … pos_18` |

Column naming: `pm_rb` = construct `C_Pm-Rb` (main analysis), `pw_rb` = construct `F_Pw-Rb`;
`delta_* = Z_mutant − Z_WT`.
